title: a16z Podcast: On Marrying Entertainment and Technology

reader_summary.headline: Both Katzenberg and Whitman have known each other for years.
reader_summary.overview: Both Katzenberg and Whitman have known each other for years, but they resided in two different worlds -- entertainment and software -- which are now merging. In this conversation, Andreessen probes them on where Hollywood comes in (or doesn't); the intersection of software and new media. Along they also touch on their unique working relationship, and leadership lessons learned...
